title: AFOOFT Dedication
description:
This book is dedicated to Andrea, who first conceived of a “family favorites” cookbook as her Penn State graduation present. We hope that we have achieved what you dreamed of. You certainly have achieved all our dreams for you! We are so proud of the young woman you have become and all that you have accomplished!
Wishing you a lifetime of happiness and many fun-filled hours in the kitchen recreating “A Few of Our Favorite Things.”
With all our love always, Mommy and Daddy
May 17, 2009
